title: Gainable traits
source: project.json CGainableTrait::LoadKey (0x73800: `combat`, `hours_required`, `trait`, `trigger`) and BiceLib GameClasses/CTrait.hpp (the six combat tokens)

file.desc: the file's own loader (0x473C70) was not read; `gainable_trait` is the only key the game and the mod use

gainable_trait.desc: one trait and what earning it takes

combat.desc: the kind of combat that earns it; the loader keeps the token, and the database is looked up by these six

hours_required.desc: hours of such combat it takes; 0 or less, or left out, and the trait comes with the first such combat

trait.desc: the trait it gives; a name traits.txt does not declare makes an empty trait

trigger.desc: conditions, in the combat's scope, checked at the end of each combat
